arabic text: HAYE QASIM HAYE QASIM\nOH QASIM OH QASIM
english translation text: HAYE QASIM HAYE QASIM\nOH QASIM OH QASIM

arabic text: HAYE QASIM HAYE QASIM\nDASHT ME IBNE HASAN PAR WAQT KAISA AAGAYAA\nOH QASIM OH QASIM
english translation text: IN THE DESERT OF KARBALA, THE SON OF HASSAN IS FACING A CALAMITY

arabic text: EK GATTHRI ME FAQAT QASIM KA LASHA AAGAYA\nDASHT ME IBNE HASANPAR WAQT KAISA AAGAYAA.
english translation text: QASIM’S BODY HAS BEEN GATHERED IN JUST ONE PIECE OF CLOTH,\nIN THE DESERT OF KARBALA, THE SON OF IMAM HASAN (A.S.) IS FACING A CALAMITY

arabic text: CHAR KANDHO PAR JANAZA GHAR ME AATA HAI MAGAR EK HI KANDHE PE YE ISKA JANAZA AAGAYAA
english translation text: A DEAD BODY IS USUALLY CARRIED ON THE SHOULDERS OF FOUR PEOPLE, BUT QASIM’S BODY WAS CARRIED ON JUST ONE SHOULDER

arabic text: JIS TARHA CHUNTAA HAI MALI PHOOL APNE BAGH KE\nTUKDE YUN QASIM KE CHUNNE MERA MAULAAAGAYAA
english translation text: THE WAY A GARDENER PICKS FLOWERS FROM HIS GARDEN, IN THAT WAY, IMAM HUSAIN (A.S.) CAME TO GATHER THE PIECES OF QASIM

arabic text: CHOOM KAR TAWIZ SARWARDER TAK ROTE RAHE\nBHAI KE LAFZO ME JAANE YAAD KYA KYA AAGAYAA
english translation text: AFTER KISSING THE TAWEEZ, IMAM CRIED FOR A LONG TIME\nWHAT MUST HE HAVE REMEMBERED AFTER READING THE LETTER OF HIS BROTHER?

arabic text: AAGAYI BARAAT RAN SE RO KE FIZZA NE KAHAA\nBIBI O TAZIM KO UTTH JAO DHULA AAGAYAA
english translation text: THE WEDDING PROCESSION HAS COME FROM THE BATTLEFIELD, FIZZA SAID CRYING,\nPAY RESPECTS AS THE GROOM COMES FROM THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: LASH KO TARTIB JAB DE-NE LAGAA ZAHRA KA LAAL\nBAARHA MAULA KI AANKHO ME ANDHERAA AAGAYAA
english translation text: WHILST GATHERING THE PIECES OF QASIM’S BODY,\nTHE SON OF ZAHRA COLLAPSED MANY TIMES

arabic text: BAAP KA TAWIZ THA BE-TE KE BAAZU PAR BANDHA\nISS LIYE PECHAAN ME QASIMKA LASHAA AAGAYAA
english translation text: THE FATHER’S TAWEEZ WAS TIED ON HIS SON’S ARM,\nTHEREFORE QASIM’S BODY COULD BE RECOGNISED

arabic text: MATAMI KE GHAR ME AKBAR JAB KOI DULHA BANA\nYAAD SAB KO KARBALA WAALE KA SEHRA AAGAYAA
english translation text: WHENEVER A WEDDING TAKES PLACE IN THE HOUSE OF AN AZAADAR,\nEVERYONE REMEMBERS THE GROOM OF KARBALA
